title: Sentinel Tier Order Schedule: Endpoint Minimums, Billing Commitments, Terms and True-Up Day
content:
For each Sentinel Managed Security tier, this schedule fixes the smallest endpoint commitment that may be ordered, the share of the commitment that is always billed, the term lengths on offer, and the day of the month on which enrolled endpoints are counted.

## Definitions

- **Minimum endpoints**: the minimum endpoints that may be ordered (whole endpoints).
- **Minimum billed commitment**: the minimum billed endpoints as a percent of the contracted endpoints, rounded up to a whole endpoint (percent).
- **Allowed terms**: the term lengths the tier may be ordered or renewed for (months).
- **True-up snapshot day**: the day of the month on which enrolled endpoints are counted for the next month's fee.

## Schedule

| Sentinel tier | Minimum endpoints | Minimum billed commitment | Allowed terms (months) | True-up snapshot day | Not available to a client whose ClearPath tier is |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sentinel EDR Essentials | 10 | 80 percent | 1 or 12 | 25th of the month | ClearPath Premier, ClearPath Enterprise |
| Sentinel MDR Standard | 10 | 90 percent | 12 or 36 | 25th of the month | (none) |
| Sentinel MDR Advanced | 25 | 90 percent | 12 or 36 | 25th of the month | (none) |
| Sentinel MDR Complete | 25 | 90 percent | 12 or 36 | 25th of the month | (none) |
| Sentinel XDR Premier | 50 | 90 percent | 12 or 36 | 25th of the month | (none) |
| Sentinel XDR Enterprise | 100 | 90 percent | 36 only | 25th of the month | (none) |

## Reading the schedule

**Minimum endpoints.** The figure is a floor on the order: on Sentinel XDR Premier an order for 50 endpoints meets it and an order for 49 does not; on Sentinel XDR Enterprise the floor is 100.

**Minimum billed commitment, worked illustration.** The percentage applies to the contracted endpoints and the result is rounded up to a whole endpoint. For a hypothetical commitment of 45 contracted endpoints on a tier showing 90 percent, 90 percent of 45 is 40.5, which rounds up to 41 billed endpoints at the least. For a hypothetical commitment of 45 contracted endpoints on Sentinel EDR Essentials at 80 percent, 80 percent of 45 is exactly 36, so 36 is the minimum. The endpoint counts here are illustrative only.

**Terms.** Sentinel EDR Essentials is the only tier offering a 1-month term, and Sentinel XDR Enterprise is offered on the 36-month term alone; every other tier offers 12 and 36 months.

**Snapshot day.** All six tiers count enrolled endpoints on the 25th day of each month.
